comparison.objective: Extract a retaining pin while supporting a weighted carriage so it does not drop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually transfers load support and pulls a load-bearing pin; it does not perform rotary adjustment or tool-mediated locking.
comparison.success_condition: Pin extraction with carriage height maintained and no constraint violation determines success; no calibrated stopping cycles or setting drift are assessed.
comparison.reason: Both concern carriage hardware and damage avoidance, but this tests support during fastener extraction, while the candidate keeps its setscrew captive and tunes an absorber. Full numeric height and pin thresholds are not included in the record body, yet the abilities are clearly different.
